suspendedAccess.heading: Suspended access
suspendedAccess.help: A request that names a role its caller does not hold is a security event. A personal access token that does it is suspended, and so is a person's token access over MCP, SQL (pgwire), Bolt, Arrow Flight and gRPC when their identity provider signed the token. A suspension stays until an administrator lifts it.
suspendedAccess.statementNeedsRight: Reading a statement needs the view_governance right.
